subject: ProjectLore 0.1 foundation CLI before retrieval and policy tools

protocol.note: The foundation CLI exposes status, validate, and schema only. Unsupported query and policy commands deterministically establish the pre-implementation baseline.

policy_false_positive_rate.note: No policy decision was produced; this is not evidence of safe behavior.

correction_rediscovery.note: No retrieval surface exists, so a correction cannot be rediscovered through ProjectLore.

latency_ms.note: Measured across 40 rejected invocations (20 per unsupported command); all exited 2. This is startup-and-error latency, not successful query latency.

context_size_bytes.note: UTF-8 size of the rejected-command response across the same 40 invocations; no usable context payload exists.
